candidate: resolved impact with external-liquidity target extension
research_question: Does treating measured travel as a minimum and routing the final objective to the nearest farther, causally open 40-bps intrinsic pool convert resolved-impact opportunities into sufficient cost-net trades without changing the entry state?

selection.method: Deterministic SHA-256 ordering of Monday BTC weeks from 2021-01-04 through 2026-07-20, excluding candidate-01 weeks already opened.

rules.fixed_state_machine: candidate v17 causal three-notional resolved impact
rules.primary_target: nearest already-confirmed and still-unconsumed same-direction 40-bps intrinsic pivot at least as far as the measured target; otherwise measured target
rules.selection_after_first_week: Use external-extended whenever it advances. Use base-measured only when the primary stops and the control advances. Freeze the selected rule before opening week two.

execution.data: Official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT aggTrades represented one-for-one as NautilusTrader TradeTick

long_evaluation_gate.prerequisite: All three frozen weeks advance, at least two are full_pass, and pooled three-week NAV geometric daily return is at least 1% before adding a continuous long runner.
long_evaluation_gate.long_run_must_be: One continuous NautilusTrader engine/account/strategy state, never stitched weekly NAV.

invalidation: Do not change the resolved-impact detector, context, clock, target rule, cost, risk, weeks or gates after opening a frozen week.
Do not open week two if both first-week target rules stop.
Do not open week three if the selected rule stops on week two.
Do not use another instrument or long period to rescue a weekly failure.
